title: Microsoft Purview DLP: remediation actions inside email notifications
summary: The briefing's remediation actions, licensing background, opt-in configuration and audit guidance are supported. It correctly reports the disagreement between the launched roadmap status and Learn's preview label. Minor corrections should complete the notification settings route and reconcile the recipient-selection checklist with the controls table.

claims.claim: The Purview route through Data loss prevention, Policies, custom policy creation and advanced rules ends at User Notifications.
claims.quote: Select Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy. ... Select Enterprise applications & devices. ... Select Custom from both the Categories list and the Regulations list. ... select + Create rule. ... Set the User Notifications toggle to On.
claims.fix: Use 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Custom (Categories) > Custom (Regulations) > Assign admin units > Choose where to apply the policy > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Customize advanced DLP rules > + Create rule > User Notifications > Preview and edit notification email'. The creation steps are at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-spo-odb-external and the final step at the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-use-notifications-and-policy-tips. Retain the note that actions are selected in the email configuration.
